name: shopping-agent
description: Minimal AI shopping experience with conversational product discovery

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/mcp-server && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
